'''5A8-3R''' was a [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|vendor droid]] found in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The droid sold [[Lightsaber/Legends|Lightsabers]] to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

==Behind the scenes==
The droid's name is a reference to the word "saber".
